DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: うう……美味しい物って、なんでこんなに高いんだろう……

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 働かずにお金が欲しい……

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: 一攫千金とか期待し過ぎないで、きちんとコツコツ仕事をしないとね

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: 私も働かずにお金を貰って暮らしたい……

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: うぅ、それはその通りだけど……

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: ……私から言い出しておいてなんだけど、先生がそんなこと言っていいの？

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: まあこれも本音だけど、アルバイトの時は私も真剣にやってるよ

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: ジュンコが、アルバイト……！？

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: ねえ、なにその反応！

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 私がアルバイトしてたら変！？

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 先生、先生！

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 私、すごいこと知っちゃった！

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: どうしたの？

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: お手頃価格で、高級な海鮮食材をたくさん食べられる方法を見つけたの！

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: 本当に？

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: ジュンコ、いくらそういうのが食べたいからって犯罪はダメだよ

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: もちろん。詳しい方法は秘密だけど……ふふっ

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 私のことを何だと思ってるの！？犯罪とかじゃないから！

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 詳しいことが知りたかったら、今夜ゲヘナの学食に来て！

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 遅くならないようにね！

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: うう……

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: あんな実験のために材料を買わなければ、贅沢な食事ができたのに……

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: ねえねえジュンコ

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: ん、なに？

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: ネットで見たんだけど、キュウリに蜂蜜を塗るとメロンの味がするらしいよ

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: またネットの情報じゃん！それに蜂蜜って十分高いよ！

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: もう騙されないんだからぁっ！

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: ふふ、ねえ先生。良いこと教えてあげよっか？

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 今日の美食研究会の夕飯はなんと……お肉！

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: お肉！

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: それも、高級な和牛！

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: 和牛！？

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: ふふ。羨ましいでしょ、先生？

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 今日は、存分に私のことを羨ましがっていいよ！

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: 私も食べたい……

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: 私も美食研究会に入る！

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: ダーメ、今日行くお店は人数制限があるから

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: その代わりに帰ってきたら、どれくらい美味しかったか教えてあげる！

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 今日のお昼は、美食研究会でケーキバイキングに行くの！

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: ケーキバイキング？

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: あれ、先生ケーキバイキング知らないの？

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: ケーキバイキングっていうのはね、

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 色んなケーキがたくさん並んでて、時間内なら好きなだけ食べられる……

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: そんな夢のようなスタイルの食事なの！

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: 途中で飽きちゃいそう……

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: そういうこと言わないで！

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: ケーキを思う存分食べられるチャンスなんて、そうそう無いんだから！

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: うぅ……

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: 具合はどう？

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: うん、ちょっとマシになってきた……

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 昆布って、あんなにお腹の中で膨れるんだ……

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: この前アカリがおやつで、味付き乾燥昆布を一袋丸ごと食べてたけど……

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: アカリのお腹、いったいどうなってるの……

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 先生、山海経の近くにある中華街の噂って聞いたことある？

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 中華料理のお店でいっぱいで、どのお店もすごく美味しいんだって！

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: 私も、噂だけは聞いたことあるよ

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: すごい美味しかったよ

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: そっか。先生の耳にも入るぐらいだし、やっぱり間違いなさそう……！

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: ええっ！私に声もかけないで、自分だけ行ってきたの！？ずるい！

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: とにかく、美食研究会の一員として、これは行くしかないでしょ

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: だから、えっと……今度の週末、もしよかったら一緒に行かない？

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: うん、行こっか

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: ふふっ、約束だよ？

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: じゃあ週末、山海経高級中学校の正門前でね！

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 先生、先生！

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: 楽しそうだね、ジュンコ

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: 珍しいし、このモモトーク画面キャプチャしておこうかな？

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: ちょっと、どういうことよ！

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: ……念のため聞くけど

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 本当に保存したわけじゃないよね？

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: してないです……

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: ならいいんだけど

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: それでね……なんと、ついに完成したの！

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: 完成したって、何が……？

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: ふふっ……今、シャーレよね？

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 直接見せてあげる！

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 待ってて、すぐ行くから！

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 으으…… 맛있는 음식은 어째서 이렇게 비싼 걸까…….

DialogKR.Speaker: Player
DialogKR.Text: 요행을 기대하지 말고 제대로 된 일을 해야지..

DialogKR.Speaker: Player
DialogKR.Text: 나도 일하지 않고 돈을 벌고 싶어…….

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 잠깐, 선생님이 그런 말을 해도 괜찮은 거야?

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 뭐, 말은 그렇게 해도 아르바이트할 때는 나도 진지하다고.

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 내가 아르바이트를 하는 게 뭐가 어때서!

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 내가 저렴한 비용으로 고급 해산물을 잔뜩 먹을 수 있는 방법을 찾아냈어!

DialogKR.Speaker: Player
DialogKR.Text: 준코, 고급 해산물이 먹고 싶어도 범죄는 저지르면 안 돼.

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 나를 뭐로 보는 거야? 범죄를 저지르려는 게 아니거든?

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 자세한 내용이 궁금하다면 오늘 저녁 시간에 맞춰 게헨나의 학원 식당으로 찾아와.

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 가짜 음식을 실험하느라 푸딩을 구입하지만 않았어도 오늘 저녁은 호화롭게 먹을 수 있었을 텐데…….

DialogKR.Speaker: Player
DialogKR.Text: 방금 인터넷에서 봤는데 오이에 꿀을 바르면 멜론 맛이 난대.

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 또 인터넷 사기냐! 게다가 꿀은 멜론보다 더 비싸잖아!

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 오늘 미식 연구회의 저녁 메뉴는…… 고기야!

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 안 돼. 가기로 한 야키니쿠 가게에는 제한 인원이 있단 말이야.

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 대신 다녀와서 와규가 얼마나 맛있었는지 잔뜩 말해줄게!

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 오늘 점심에는 미식연구회 부원들과 함께 케이크 뷔페에 갈 거야!

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 뭐야, 선생님. 케이크 뷔페를 모르는 거야?

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 여러 가지 종류의 케이크가 잔뜩 진열되어 있고, 제한 시간 동안 그 케이크를 마음껏 먹을 수 있는

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 케이크를 마음껏 먹을 수 있는 기회는 쉽게 없다고!

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 설마 말린 다시마가 뱃속에서 불어날 거라고는 생각도 못 했어…….

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 그나저나 저번에 보니 아카리는 간식으로 마른 다시마 한 통을 통째로 먹어 치우던데…….

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 아카리의 뱃속은 도대체 어떻게 된 거지…….

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 선생님, 산해경 학원 근처에 있는 중화가의 소문 들었어?

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 거리가 중화 요릿집으로 가득 들어차 있는데, 모두 하나같이 맛집이래!

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 선생님의 귀에도 들어갈 정도면 확실히 맛집은 맛집인가 보네.

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 뭐야. 나만 빼놓고 이미 다녀온 거야? 치사해!

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 어찌 되었든 미식을 추구하는 미식연구회의 일원으로서 이 소식을 그냥 넘길 수는 없지.

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 그래서 말인데…… 이번 주말에 시간 괜찮으면 산해경 학원에 같이 가지 않을래?

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 그럼 주말에 산해경 학원 정문 앞에서 보자!

DialogKR.Speaker: Player
DialogKR.Text: 준코가 신나서 나를 찾다니, 뭔가 신선하네.

DialogKR.Speaker: Player
DialogKR.Text: 기념으로 이 모모톡, 캡처해서 보존해 둘까?

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 후후후…… 만나서 보면 알게 될 거야.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Ugh... Why must delicious food be so expensive...

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: I wish I could make money without having to work...

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: You shouldn't expect any shortcuts. You need a real job.

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: I want to make money without working too...

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: That's true, but...

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Wait, is it really okay for a teacher to say something like that?

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Well, you may say that, but I take my part-time job seriously.

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: You have a part-time job, Junko?

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: What's that supposed to mean?

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: What's wrong with me working a part-time job?!

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Sensei, Sensei!

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: I just found out something incredible!

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: What's up?

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: I've found a way to eat tons of premium seafood for really cheap!

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: Really?

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: Junko, you shouldn't break the law, even for fine seafood.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Yeah. But I can't tell you the details yet. Heehee.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: What do you take me for? I'm not committing any crimes!

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: If you wanna know the details, come to the Gehenna Academy dining hall at dinner today.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Don't be late!

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Ugh.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: If I hadn't bought that pudding to experiment with the fake food, I could have had a really nice dinner tonight...

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: Junko.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: What?

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: I saw on the Internet that if you put honey on cucumber, it tastes like melon.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Another internet fraud! Besides, honey is more expensive than the melon itself!

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: I won't be fooled by fake food again!

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Heehee! Sensei, you're gonna be so jealous.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: For tonight's dinner, the Gourmet Research Society is having...meat!

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: ...Meat!

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: And not just any meat! We'll be enjoying premium wagyu!

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: ...Wagyu!

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Heehee. Are you jealous, Sensei?

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: You should be green with envy today!

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: I want some too...

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: I'm joining the Gourmet Research Society!

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: No. The yakiniku restaurant we're going to only accepts smaller groups.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: But I'll tell you how good the wagyu was when I get back!

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: For lunch today, I'm going to a cake buffet with the other members of the Gourmet Research Society!

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: A cake buffet?

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: What, do you not know what a cake buffet is, Sensei?

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Well, then, I'll explain.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: It's a restaurant where they set out all kinds of cakes, and it's all-you-can-eat.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: It's basically the restaurant of my dreams.

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: That sounds like it could make you sick...

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Don't be such a baby!

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: You don't get many chances to eat unlimited cake!

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Ugh...

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: How's your stomach?

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: I feel a little better now.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: I never thought that dried kelp would bloat me like that...

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Last time, I saw Akari eat a whole box of dried kelp as a snack...

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: What's so special about Akari's stomach?

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Sensei, did you hear about the Chinese quarter near Shanhaijing Academy?

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: The streets there are full of Chinese restaurants, and they say that all of them are awesome!

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: I've heard the same thing.

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: Yeah, the food is just as good as they say.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: If you know about it, then it must be really great.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: What? You already went without me? You're so mean!

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Anyway, as a member of the Gourmet Research Society and master of gastronomy, I can't ignore this news.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: So, I was wondering... If you have time this weekend, would you like to go to Shanhaijing Academy with me?

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: Sure.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Heehee! You promise?

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Then I'll see you in front of Shanhaijing Academy main gate this weekend!

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Sensei, Sensei!

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: Are you...excited to talk to me? That's something new.

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: I should take a screenshot of our MomoTalk so we never forget this moment.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: What gibberish are you rambling about?!

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: I...have to ask.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: You didn't really screenshot it, did you?

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: Of course not.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Okay, good.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: It's finally done!

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: What is?

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Heeheehee... You'll see when we meet up.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Are you at Schale?

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: I'll be right there!

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
เฮ้อ... ทำไมอาหารอร่อยๆ ถึงได้แพง
ขนาดนี้นะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: อยากหาเงินได้โดยไม่ต้องทำงานจัง

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text:
อย่าหวังแต่โชคช่วย แล้วไปตั้งใจ
ทำงานเถอะ...

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text:
ครูก็อยากได้เงินโดยไม่ต้องทำงาน
เหมือนกัน...

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: แต่ถึงอย่างนั้นก็เถอะ...

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: เดี๋ยวนะ คุณครูพูดอะไรแบบนี้ได้ด้วยเหรอ?

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
ถึงจะพูดแบบนั้นก็เถอะ ตอนทำงาน
พาร์ทไทม์ฉันขยันมากนะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: จุนโกะทำพาร์ทไทม์เหรอ?

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: ถามเหมือนไม่เชื่อกันเลย

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: ฉันดูไม่เหมือนเด็กที่ทำพาร์ทไทม์ได้เหรอ?

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: คุณครู... คุณครู!

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: ฉันไปรู้เรื่องน่าทึ่งมาล่ะ!

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: เรื่องอะไรเหรอ?

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
วิธีที่จะได้กินอาหารทะเลคุณภาพสูงใน
ราคาถูกยังไงล่ะ!

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: ไปรู้มาได้ยังไง?

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text:
นี่จุนโกะ ถึงจะอยากกินของดีๆ แต่ก็
ห้ามไปก่อเรื่องนะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
แน่นอนอยู่แล้ว แต่ฉันไม่บอกหรอกนะว่า
ต้องทำยังไง หุหุ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
เห็นฉันเป็นคนยังไงกัน? ฉันไม่ได้จะไป
ก่อเรื่องอะไรสักหน่อย?

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
ถ้าอยากรู้วิธีนี้ล่ะก็ เย็นนี้มาที่โรงอาหาร
ของเกเฮนน่าสิ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: ห้ามสายเลยนะ!

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: เฮ้อ...

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
ถ้าวันนี้ไม่ซื้อพุดดิ้งเพื่อทดลองอาหาร
ปลอมๆ วันนี้ก็คงได้กินอาหารเย็นมื้อ
แพงๆ ไปแล้ว

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: จุนโกะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: ทำไมเหรอ?

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text:
ครูเจอมาในเน็ตว่าหากเอาน้ำผึ้งทา
แตงกวา จะมีรสเหมือนเมล่อนล่ะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
เพ้อเจ้อน่า! อีกอย่าง น้ำผึ้งน่ะแพงกว่า
เมล่อนอีก!

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
ฉันจะไม่ถูกหลอกเพราะเรื่องอาหาร
ปลอมหรอก

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: ฮุฮุ คุณครูจะอิจฉาฉันก็ได้นะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
เพราะเมนูอาหารเย็นของชมรมชิมอาหาร
วันนี้คือ... เนื้อย่าง!

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: เนื้อย่าง...!

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: เนื้อวากิวราคาแพงเลยล่ะ!

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: เนื้อวากิว...!

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: ฮุฮุ อิจฉาใช่ไหมล่ะ?

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: วันนี้ฉันจะให้อิจฉาได้วันนึง!

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: ครูก็อยากกินนะ...

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: ครูไปเข้าชมรมชิมอาหารด้วยดีกว่า

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
ไม่ได้! เพราะร้านยากินิกุที่เราจะไปกัน
จำกัดจำนวนคนน่ะสิ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
เอาเป็นว่า ฉันจะกลับมาเล่าให้ฟังแล้วกัน
ว่าเนื้อย่างอร่อยแค่ไหน

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
อาหารกลางวันของฉันและสมาชิกชมรม
วันนี้คือบุฟเฟต์เค้ก!

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: บุฟเฟต์เค้กเหรอ?

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: อะไรกันคุณครู ไม่รู้จักบุฟเฟต์เค้กเหรอ?

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: บุฟเฟต์เค้กน่ะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
มีเค้กให้กินหลายประเภทเลย แถมกิน
ได้มากเท่าที่ต้องการเลยล่ะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: ร้านแห่งความฝันของฉันเลย

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: กินเยอะๆ น่าจะเลี่ยนนะ...

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: พูดอะไรเหมือนคนอ่อนแอเลย!

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: โอกาสในการกินเค้กไม่อั้นไม่ได้มีบ่อยๆ นะ!

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: เป็นยังไงบ้าง?

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: ดีขึ้นบ้างแล้วล่ะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
ไม่คิดเลยว่าสาหร่ายอบแห้งจะไปบวม
ในท้องได้...

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
แต่ว่าคราวก่อนอาคาริก็กินสาหร่ายอบ
แห้งเป็นของว่างตั้งเยอะนี่นา...

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: หรือว่าอาคาริจะกระเพาะเหล็ก...

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
คุณครู ได้ยินข่าวลือเกี่ยวกับไชน่าทาวน์
แถวๆ ซานไห่จิงบ้างไหม?

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
เห็นว่าที่นั่นมีร้านอาหารจีนฟิวชั่นเยอะ
เลยล่ะ แถมอาหารยังอร่อยอีกด้วย!

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: ครูได้ยินมาแค่ข่าวลือน่ะ แต่ไม่เคยไป

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: อื้ม อาหารอร่อยเหมือนที่พูดกันเลย

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
หากคุณครูก็ได้ยินข่าวลือนี้มา แสดงว่า
ต้องเป็นร้านเด็ดจริงๆ แน่เลย

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
อะไรนะ? ทำไมไม่ชวนฉันไปกินด้วยล่ะ?
ไม่แฟร์เลย!

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
ในฐานะสมาชิกชมรมชิมอาหาร ฉันไม่
ยอมปล่อยเรื่องนี้ให้ผ่านไปได้

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
ถ้าคุณครูว่าง สุดสัปดาห์นี้เราไปที่โรง
เรียนซานไห่จิงกันไหม?

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: ไปสิ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: ฮุฮุ สัญญาแล้วนะ?

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
งั้นไว้เจอกันที่ประตูหน้าของโรงเรียน
ซานไห่จิงนะ!

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: คุณครู คุณครู!

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text:
จุนโกะมาหาครูด้วยท่าทางดีใจแบบนี้
แปลกตาจังเลยน้า

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: แคปแชตเก็บไว้เป็นที่ระลึกดีมั้ยนะ?

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: พูดอะไรแปลกๆ อีกแล้วเนี่ย!

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: แค่ถามเผื่อไว้ก่อนนะ...

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: คงไม่ได้แคปเก็บเอาไว้จริงๆ หรอกใช่มั้ย?

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: ไม่แคปหรอก...

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: ถ้างั้นก็แล้วไป

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: ในที่สุดก็เสร็จสมบูรณ์แล้วละ!

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: สมบูรณ์แบบงั้นเหรอ อะไรน่ะ?

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: ฮุฮุฮุ... เดี๋ยวเจอกันก็รู้เองแหละ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: ตอนนี้อยู่ที่ชาเล่ต์ใช่มั้ย?

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: เดี๋ยวฉันไปหา!

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 嗚嗚……好吃的東西為什麼這麼貴呢……

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: 別指望一攫千金，要好好工作才行

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: 我也想要不勞而獲地過活……

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: ……雖然是我先說出口的，但老師說這種話沒問題嗎？

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 雖然是真心話，但我打工時也是很認真的唷

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 我知道了件很厲害的事！

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 有個能以實惠價格大吃高級海鮮食材的方法！

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: 淳子，再怎麼想吃那種東西也不能犯罪啊

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 當然。不過詳細的方法是祕密……呵呵

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 你把我想成什麼了！？才不是犯罪！

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 如果想知道詳情，今晚來格黑娜的餐廳吧！

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 如果沒有為那種實驗買材料，就能吃頓豪華大餐了……

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: 我在網路上看到，黃瓜塗蜂蜜好像會有哈密瓜的味道

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 又是網路資訊啊！而且蜂蜜就已經夠貴了！

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 呵呵，嘿，老師。能告訴你一件好事嗎？

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 今天美食研究會的晚餐竟然是……肉！

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: 我也要加入美食研究會！

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 不行，今天去的店有人數限制

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 但是回來後，我會告訴你有多好吃！

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 今天中午，要跟美食研究會去蛋糕自助餐！

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 咦，老師不知道蛋糕自助餐嗎？

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 擺放著各式各樣的蛋糕，在時間內可以隨便吃……

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 可以盡情吃蛋糕的機會可不是隨時都有！

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 昆布竟然在肚子裡膨脹得這麼厲害……

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 前幾天看到亞伽里把一整袋調味乾昆布當作點心吃……

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 亞伽里的肚子到底是怎麼回事……

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 老師，聽說過山海經附近的中華街嗎？

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 有很多中華料理店，而且每一間都很好吃！

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 這樣啊。消息都傳進老師的耳朵了，看來準沒錯……！

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 咦咦──！不跟我說一聲就自己跑去！？真狡猾！

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 總之，身為美食研究會的一員，只能去了吧

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 所以，那個……這個週末，如果可以的話，要一起去嗎？

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 那麼週末，在山海經高級中學的正門口前見唷！

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: 真難得，把這個MomoTalk的畫面截圖留作紀念吧？

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 你該不會真的截圖了吧？

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 我想說的是……終於完成了！

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 呵呵……你現在在夏萊對吧？

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 等我一下，我現在就過去！
